userStories.title: Delete the review operations
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove the unreachable pipeline review operations, fix-review runner, and applyReviewsFailedOpen without changing run-summary aggregation.

**Motivation** — Their last reference outside their own tests is `applyReviewsFailedOpen` (`execution/post-run-review-summary.ts:16`), which lost its only caller in B2b-1 and was left for this wave.

**Approach** — Removal only, importer-first, in three layers: the operations first, then the prompt builders the operations imported, then the review leaves both imported. Every story leaves a tree that compiles and passes the suite. No story adds a feature or changes a workflow-mode result.

### Part 1: the review operations (US-001)

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `operations/index.ts:2-3` | the `adversarial-review` type and value re-exports go |
| `operations/index.ts:57-58` | the `fix-review` type and value re-exports go |
| `operations/index.ts:97-105` | the `nbf-worth-check` and `nbf-worth-check-audit` type and value re-exports go |
| `operations/index.ts:123-124` | the `semantic-review` type and value re-exports go |
| `execution/post-run-review-summary.ts` | `applyReviewsFailedOpen` (`:15-26`), its `../operations` and `PipelineContext` imports (`:12-13`) and the doc-comment sentence about it (`:7-8`) go; `sumReviewsFailedOpen` is unchanged |
| `test/helpers/index.ts:195` | the `review-outputs` re-export goes with the helper |

Deleted: `operations/semantic-review.ts`, `adversarial-review.ts`, `adversarial-requote.ts`, `adversarial-reprompt-marker.ts`, `_review-fallback.ts`, `fix-review.ts`, `nbf-worth-check.ts`, `nbf-worth-check-audit.ts`, and `review/fix-review/run/index.ts`.

All source deletion paths above are below packages/nax/src/, with the operation siblings under operations/. First cut the barrel and applyReviewsFailedOpen importers, then delete these nine source files.

Test deletions, all below packages/nax/test/: unit/operations/semantic-review.test.ts, semantic-review-reground.test.ts, semantic-review-verify.test.ts, adversarial-review.test.ts, adversarial-review-reground.test.ts, adversarial-review-reground-cost.test.ts, adversarial-review-requote.test.ts, adversarial-review-verify.test.ts, adversarial-advisory-findings.test.ts, recurrence-stamps.test.ts, reviewer-verdict-invariant.test.ts, reviewer-tools.test.ts, fix-review.test.ts, and nbf-worth-check.test.ts (all preceding sibling names are under unit/operations/); unit/review/adversarial-retry-truncation.test.ts, unit/review/audit-shape.test.ts, unit/review/fix-review/run.test.ts, unit/review/surviving-review-helpers.test.ts; helpers/review-outputs.ts. The surviving-review-helpers test is deleted now because it imports adversarial-reprompt-marker, although its other helpers are removed only in US-003.

Mixed-test edits: in test/unit/operations/bash-declarations.test.ts remove only the adversarial-review and semantic-review imports and rows in 'ops that may hold Bash'; in tool-declarations.test.ts remove only the adversarial-review import and row in 'read-only ops gain neither'; in timeout-resolvers.test.ts remove the semanticReviewOp and adversarialReviewOp timeout tests/imports while retaining planInteractiveOp and decomposeOp assertions. In test/unit/execution/post-run-review-summary.test.ts remove only the applyReviewsFailedOpen describe/imports and retain the sumReviewsFailedOpen assertions. Remove the helpers/index.ts review-outputs re-export with its helper.

Apply the shared four-step verification protocol in analysis, including per-deleted-source/test path sweeps and stale-comment cleanup. Update scripts/baselines/complexity-baseline.json via bun run check:complexity:update, remove deleted-source coverage entries and deleted-test escape-hatch entries, and lower the file-size baseline only if reported. Keep every other baseline threshold.

**Scope** — In: the nine listed source deletions, operation/helper export cuts, the applyReviewsFailedOpen removal, associated test deletions/trims and baseline cleanup. Out: US-002's prompt builders and adapter; US-003's review leaves and retained-helper reductions. Do not remove configuration keys/selectors or deleted-operation/role strings from registries; later waves own those. Workflow review and sumReviewsFailedOpen remain unchanged.

**Interface** — Existing read-only integration signature from the spec: `sumReviewsFailedOpen(allStoryMetrics: readonly StoryMetrics[]): number | undefined` (`execution/post-run-review-summary.ts:33`). No new externally-visible symbol. This story only removes exports.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] Regression guard: sumReviewsFailedOpen, imported from @/execution/post-run-review-summary, returns 3 when given two story metrics whose reviewsFailedOpen values are 1 and 2.
[unit] Regression guard: sumReviewsFailedOpen, imported from @/execution/post-run-review-summary, returns undefined when given story metrics with no reviewsFailedOpen.
[unit] Negative-path regression guard: sumReviewsFailedOpen([]) returns undefined rather than zero when no story metrics are available.

routing.reasoning: The nine source deletions plus barrels, mixed tests, helpers, and baselines justify complex coordination, but all reachable behavior is preserved, making no-test lighter and more realistic than a three-session TDD cycle for dead-code deletion.
routing.noTestJustification: Pure structural removal of unreachable pipeline code; sumReviewsFailedOpen and its empty/absent-metric behavior remain unchanged and already have regression tests. Retain/adapt those tests and perform the mandatory suite and path sweeps; no new runtime behavior requires a failing-test implementation cycle.

userStories.title: Delete the review prompt builders and the diff-access adapter
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Remove five pipeline review prompt builders and the legacy diff-access adapter, preserving the existing live protocol renderer through equivalent fixtures.

**Motivation** — Workflow review does not use any of this.

**Approach** — Removal only, importer-first, in three layers: the operations first, then the prompt builders the operations imported, then the review leaves both imported. Every story leaves a tree that compiles and passes the suite. No story adds a feature or changes a workflow-mode result.

### Part 2: the review prompt builders and the diff-access adapter (US-002)

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `prompts/index.ts:19-21` | the `adversarial-review-builder` re-exports (`AdversarialReviewPromptOptions`, `TestInventory`, `AdversarialReviewPromptBuilder`) and their comment go |
| `prompts/index.ts:23`, `:62-63`, `:75-76`, `:87`, `:95-97` | the `fix-review-builder`, `nbf-worth-check-builder`, `prior-iterations-builder` and `review-builder` re-exports and their comments go, including the stray "Fix-review prompt builder" comment at `:23` above the `advisor-builder` export |
| `prompts/index.ts:183-184` | re-exports only `buildOutOfScopeLines` from `./sections`; the comment above it no longer mentions the reviewer prompts |
| `prompts/sections/index.ts:17` | re-exports only `buildOutOfScopeLines` from `./out-of-scope` |
| `prompts/sections/out-of-scope.ts` | `buildReviewOutOfScopeBlock` (`:43` onward) and the doc comments that describe the review block go; `buildOutOfScopeLines` is unchanged |

Deleted: `prompts/builders/review-builder.ts`, `adversarial-review-builder.ts`, `fix-review-builder.ts`, `nbf-worth-check-builder.ts`, `prior-iterations-builder.ts`, and `prompts/sections/diff-access.ts`.

`diff-access.ts` is the legacy adapter: `wrapDiffAccess(spec, body)` returns `wrapAffordance("diff-access", spec, body)` and `applyDiffAccess` calls `applyProtocolRegions`, both from `prompts/sections/protocol-region.ts`. Only the deleted review builders produced diff-access regions in production. The `diff-access` entry in the protocol-region registry, its native renderer and `applyDiffAccessForAgentProtocol` (`agents/tool-preamble.ts`) stay. Kept tests that built a diff-access fixture with `wrapDiffAccess` build it with `wrapAffordance("diff-access", spec, body)` imported from `@/prompts/sections`, which yields the same bytes, so their assertions on the live renderer keep their meaning.

All deletion paths are below packages/nax/src/; the builder sibling names are under prompts/builders/. Cut the exports and review-only scope block and migrate retained tests before removing the six source files. Keep the live advisor builder export despite its adjacent obsolete comment.

Test deletions below packages/nax/test/: unit/prompts/review-builder.test.ts and unit/prompts/__snapshots__/review-builder.test.ts.snap; unit/prompts/adversarial-review-builder.test.ts, unit/prompts/diff-access.test.ts, unit/prompts/review-diff-frame-ssot.test.ts, unit/prompts/sections/diff-access-gating.test.ts; unit/prompts/builders/fix-review-builder.test.ts, nbf-worth-check-builder.test.ts, prior-iterations-builder.test.ts, and prior-iterations-builder-token-guard.test.ts (the last four are all under unit/prompts/builders/).

Mixed-test edits below packages/nax/test/: in unit/prompts/sections/out-of-scope.test.ts remove only buildReviewOutOfScopeBlock's describe/import and retain buildOutOfScopeLines assertions. In unit/prompts/sections/protocol-region.test.ts remove the describe 'cross-entry seam with the retained diff-access adapter', its preceding legacy comment block, the applyDiffAccess/wrapDiffAccess imports, and nonceFromMarker plus its doc comment; reword the header reference to the deleted diff-access.test.ts and keep every other describe's assertions. In unit/agents/tool-preamble.test.ts replace the wrapDiffAccess fixture with wrapAffordance("diff-access", { ref: "abc123", fullExclude: [".", ":!.nax/"] }, "SHELL BODY\n"), importing wrapAffordance from @/prompts/sections, and retain all existing native/ACP/gating assertions. Exercise the exact acceptance prompt with fullExclude:["."] as well. In unit/operations/build-hop-callback-diff-access.test.ts convert EVERY wrapDiffAccess fixture call to wrapAffordance("diff-access", spec, body), preserving the original spec/body arguments and assertions; current code has calls at lines 49, 391, 404, 450, and 482. Convert the unit/runtime/session-run-hop.test.ts fixture at line 572 likewise. These are fixture changes, not changes to dispatch or session lifecycle.

In unit/operations/run-operation-retry.test.ts, the tests 'op.retry runs all attempts in a single session (Phase A same-session regression)' and 'cost is summed across retry attempts via sendWithParseRetry' must no longer depend on ReviewPromptBuilder or validateLLMShape. Each validate callback becomes a local check that the parsed value is an object with a boolean passed field, and each retry prompt becomes a local string constant; the assertions stay unchanged. Remove those imports now so US-003 can delete semantic-helpers without breaking this kept test.

Apply the shared four-step verification protocol in analysis, including path sweeps for every removed source/test/snapshot and stale-comment cleanup. Update complexity, deleted-source coverage, deleted-test escape-hatch baselines, and lower file sizes only when reported.

**Scope** — In: the six source deletions, review-only scope block and export removal, retained-fixture migrations, deleted-builder/adapter tests, and baselines. Out: US-001's operations, already removed; US-003's review leaves, diff-utils reductions, and AC-quote validator deletion. Keep the diff-access affordance kind, native renderer, applyProtocolRegions, applyDiffAccessForAgentProtocol, buildOutOfScopeLines, workflow review builders, bot PR review builder, and retry/session algorithms unchanged.

**Interface** — Existing integration signatures verbatim from the spec: `wrapAffordance(kind: string, spec: unknown, acpBody: string): string` and `applyProtocolRegions(prompt: string, options)` (`prompts/sections/protocol-region.ts`), exported from `@/prompts/sections`; `applyDiffAccessForAgentProtocol(agentName, prompt, advertisedTools)` (`agents/tool-preamble.ts`). Target: exports `buildOutOfScopeLines` and no review block builder. No new externally-visible symbol. Each story only removes exports. US-002 switches kept tests from `wrapDiffAccess` to the existing `wrapAffordance`, and its AC drives `applyDiffAccessForAgentProtocol`, the function the agent preamble calls on every dispatched prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] Regression guard: applyDiffAccessForAgentProtocol("native", prompt, ["Git", "Read"]), where prompt is "head\n" + wrapAffordance("diff-access", { ref: "abc123", fullExclude: ["."] }, "SHELL BODY\n") + "tail" with wrapAffordance imported from @/prompts/sections, returns text that names abc123 and contains neither SHELL BODY nor nax:diff-access.

[unit] Regression guard: applyDiffAccessForAgentProtocol("claude", prompt, ["Git", "Read"]), where prompt is "head
" + wrapAffordance("diff-access", { ref: "abc123", fullExclude: ["."] }, "SHELL BODY
") + "tail" with wrapAffordance imported from @/prompts/sections, returns exactly "head
SHELL BODY
tail".

[unit] Negative-path regression guard: applyDiffAccessForAgentProtocol("native", prompt, ["Read"]) returns exactly "head
SHELL BODY
tail" when prompt is "head
" + wrapAffordance("diff-access", { ref: "abc123", fullExclude: ["."] }, "SHELL BODY
") + "tail", preserving the existing ACP-body fallback when Git is not advertised.

routing.reasoning: Six source deletions and multiple retained prompt/dispatch fixtures require complex cross-module coordination, while byte-equivalent fixture substitution and unchanged live rendering make no-test appropriate; no session implementation or access-control policy is changed.
routing.noTestJustification: Pure structural deletion of unreachable prompt builders and a redundant adapter. wrapAffordance produces the same fixture bytes and the live renderer, dispatch helper, tool gate, retry loop, and session behavior are unchanged. Retain/adapt existing tests and assert the specified native/ACP/fallback regressions without a new-behavior TDD cycle.

userStories.title: Delete the review leaves and the AC-quote validator
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Delete seventeen pipeline-only review leaves, including the AC-quote validator, and trim explicitly named shared modules to their retained interfaces.

**Motivation** — The AC-quote validator (`review/ac-quote-validator.ts`) filters semantic and adversarial findings by `acQuote` / `scopeQuote` grounding; only those two operations and their prompt builders call it.

**Approach** — Removal only, importer-first, in three layers: the operations first, then the prompt builders the operations imported, then the review leaves both imported. Every story leaves a tree that compiles and passes the suite. No story adds a feature or changes a workflow-mode result.

### Part 3: the review leaves (US-003)

| Site | After |
|:---|:---|
| `review/index.ts` | the re-exports of `ac-quote-validator`, `acks`, `adversarial-helpers`, `categorization`, `category-fix-target`, `finding-filters`, `no-dispatch`, `prepare-inputs`, `recurrence-demotion`, `requote-response`, `review-iteration-store`, `semantic-categories`, `semantic-evidence` and `semantic-helpers` and their comments go; `diff-utils`, `severity`, `truncation` and `types` stay |
| `review/fix-review/index.ts` | re-exports only `changedPathsBetween` and `snapshotWorkingTree` from `./tree-snapshot`; its doc comment describes only that |
| `review/fix-review/tree-snapshot/index.ts` | `diffBetween` (`:237` onward), `DIFF_PATHSPECS` (`:35`) and their doc comments (`:31-34`) go, and the module header (`:14-21`) lists only `snapshotWorkingTree` and `changedPathsBetween` and says both throw; those two functions are unchanged |
| `review/diff-utils.ts` | `collectDiff` (`:131`), `collectDiffStat` (`:162`), `TestInventory` (`:106`), `computeTestInventory` (`:268`) and its private helpers `DEFAULT_SUFFIX_STRIPPERS`, `buildSuffixStrippers` and `stripTestSuffix` (`:229-256`) go, with imports only they used; `collectDiffFileList`, `resolveEffectiveRef`, `truncateDiff`, `ALWAYS_EXCLUDED`, `DIFF_CAP_BYTES` and `_diffUtilsDeps` stay |
| `review/types.ts` | `SemanticStory` (`:71` onward) goes |
| `test-runners/resolver.ts`, `test-runners/index.ts:42` | `resolveReviewExcludePatterns` (`:233`) and its barrel re-export go, with the private constants only it used (`WELL_KNOWN_TEST_DIRS` `:67`, `WELL_KNOWN_TEST_SUFFIXES` `:74`, `NAX_NOISE_PATHS` `:77`) and the `extractWholeTestDirs` import (`:27`); `extractWholeTestDirs` stays exported from `test-runners/conventions.ts` |
| `plugins/builtin/curator/heuristics.ts:9` | imports `normalizeIssueText` from `@/findings/fingerprint` instead of `@/review`: the `@/review` barrel reached it only through `review/recurrence-demotion.ts:12`, which this story deletes, and the curator is live (`commands/curator.ts`, wired in `bin/nax.ts`) |

Deleted: under `review/`: `ac-quote-validator.ts`, `acks.ts`, `adversarial-helpers.ts`, `categorization.ts`, `category-fix-target.ts`, `finding-filters.ts`, `no-dispatch.ts`, `prepare-inputs.ts`, `recurrence-demotion.ts`, `requote-response.ts`, `review-iteration-store.ts`, `semantic-categories/index.ts`, `semantic-evidence.ts`, `semantic-helpers.ts`, `fix-review/config.ts`, `fix-review/scope.ts`, `fix-review/types.ts`. After this story `src/review/semantic-categories/` and `src/review/fix-review/run/` no longer exist.

All source paths above are below packages/nax/src/. Perform the barrel cuts, direct curator import, specified shared-module reductions, and retained-test fixture decoupling before deleting the seventeen leaves. The AC-quote validator is pipeline-only and is deleted, not repaired, which resolves #2822 (its carve-out test passes vacuously; the test goes with the validator). Do not broaden the deletion to other orphan declarations.

Test deletions below packages/nax/test/: unit/review/ac-quote-validator.test.ts, acks.test.ts, adversarial-fixtarget.test.ts, categorization.test.ts, category-fix-target.test.ts, orchestrator-vs-reconciliation-parity.test.ts, parse-boundary-recurrence.test.ts, prepare-inputs.test.ts, recurrence-demotion.test.ts, requote-response.test.ts, review-iteration-store.test.ts, semantic-categories.test.ts, semantic-evidence.test.ts (all thirteen are under unit/review/); unit/review/fix-review/config.test.ts and unit/review/fix-review/scope.test.ts; integration/review/diff-path-convention.test.ts. Remove the validator's entire test file, including the vacuous carve-out case.

Mixed-test edits below packages/nax/test/: in unit/review/fix-review/index-exports.test.ts remove only the unified-diff, deterministic-scope, and model-resolution re-export tests/import references; keep snapshot/changed-path function assertions and reword the header. In integration/review/diff-always-excluded.test.ts remove the two collectDiff tests, the collectDiffStat test, the cwd-level .nax load-bearing test, their imports, and the now-unused libDir helper; retain the collectDiffFileList exclusion test's assertions. In unit/review/diff-utils.test.ts remove the collectDiff(), collectDiffStat(), computeTestInventory() path convention, computeTestInventory(), and collectDiff() BUG-31 hung-git describes, their imports, the makeCapturingSpawnMock helper used only by them, and obsolete header bullets; retain resolveEffectiveRef(), truncateDiff(), and collectDiffFileList assertions. In integration/review/fix-review/tree-snapshot.test.ts remove the diffBetween describe/import, and rename the mixed package-workdir test to 'changedPathsBetween from a package workdir reports repo-wide changes', dropping its diffBetween call and diff-assertion loop while keeping its paths assertion. Preserve snapshotWorkingTree, changedPathsBetween, nested-repo filter safety, awkward-path, SHA-256, and git-timeout assertions. In unit/test-runners/resolver.test.ts remove only the resolveReviewExcludePatterns describe/import while keeping resolveTestFilePatterns and findPackageDir assertions.

In unit/review/review-audit.test.ts remove imports of toAdversarialReviewFindings, tagCoverageGap, and toReviewFindings because their modules are deleted. Remove formatAdvisorySummary only because its two remaining consumers are the removed #1816 producer tests. In 'ReviewAuditor.getAdvisoryFindings', replace each producer-built advisoryFindings fixture with hand-written typed Finding literals, with no as unknown as cast. Preserve the fields each test asserts: Finding.message carries the old producer's issue text, meta.coverageGap:true supplies the coverage-gap marker, and actionRequired:false supplies #1359's non-actionable flag. Delete only 'carries the reviewer’s text through from the adversarial producer (#1816)' and 'carries the reviewer’s text through from the semantic producer (#1816)' producer tests; keep writeReviewAudit and ReviewAuditor assertions. Ensure a single hand-built coverage-gap finding and the real barrel-to-snapshot-to-changed-path integration seam exercise the stated regression guards. Do not change review-audit.ts behavior.

Apply the shared four-step verification protocol in analysis, including per-file source/test path sweeps, known stale comments, complexity regeneration, deleted-source coverage and deleted-test escape-hatch entry removal, and lowerable file-size entries. Verify the final 32-source deletion set without deleting later-wave modules merely to satisfy an estimate.

**Scope** — In: the seventeen listed leaf deletions, named shared declarations/barrels, live curator import repair, retained audit/snapshot fixtures, corresponding tests and baselines. Out: US-001's operation/runner layer and US-002's builders/legacy adapter, already removed. Keep workflow review, review-audit, snapshotWorkingTree, changedPathsBetween, and the named diff utilities unchanged. Newly orphaned findings/TDD/acceptance code, findingRecurrenceKey/fingerprintFor, extractWholeTestDirs, isTestFile, configuration selectors/keys, and operation/role registries belong to later waves; do not remove them here.

**Interface** — Verbatim target from the spec: `review/fix-review/index.ts` barrel. Target: exports exactly `changedPathsBetween` and `snapshotWorkingTree`. Existing read-only integration symbols: `ReviewAuditor` and `getAdvisoryFindings` (`review/review-audit.ts`); `snapshotWorkingTree` and `changedPathsBetween` (`review/fix-review/tree-snapshot/index.ts`), `collectDiffFileList` (`review/diff-utils.ts:328`). Current retained signatures, unchanged: `snapshotWorkingTree(workdir: string): Promise<string>`; `changedPathsBetween(workdir: string, from: string, to: string): Promise<string[]>`. No new externally-visible symbol.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] Regression guard: ReviewAuditor.getAdvisoryFindings() returns one summary entry whose coverageGap is true after recordDecision with an advisoryFindings list holding one hand-built finding whose meta.coverageGap is true.
[integration] Regression guard: the exports of @/review/fix-review are exactly snapshotWorkingTree and changedPathsBetween, both functions.

[integration] Regression guard: changedPathsBetween returns a list containing a new file's repo-relative path when called on a temporary git repository between HEAD and a snapshotWorkingTree tree taken after writing that file, using the functions imported from @/review/fix-review.

(3) Run bun run check:complexity:update; run bun run check:file-sizes -- --update-baseline when lowerable entries are reported. Baseline cleanup and gates are implementation verification, not acceptance criteria or separate stories.

Risks and mitigation: the principal risk is deleting a leaf before all operations/builders/tests/barrels that import it, mitigated by the strict dependency chain and compiling each story independently. Path-based tests, dynamic imports, baselines, and stale comments are not all captured by a simple import search, hence the mandatory path sweep. Mixed tests contain live regression value; trim only the specified sections and preserve assertions. The protocol adapter's removal must not remove its live affordance renderer or capability gating; assert byte-exact ACP output and native reference/marker hygiene. Direct typed audit fixtures must use message rather than the deleted producers' issue input field. Keep snapshot semantics and hardened git execution untouched. About fifty tests/helpers and seventeen mixed-test trims are estimates, not deletion quotas; the explicit paths and reference sweep govern. Failure Handling in the spec is 'None': this adds no input, error, or exit path, and missing references are compile/sweep failures rather than new runtime requirements.
